meta.title: Irreverent Gluttony - 2
meta.description: Grand words and elegant phrasing cannot hide the emptiness of your heart.

units.rawText: Eucharist opens the door to the Pantheon. After a thorough sweep, she was sure that she was the only person in this vast space.
units.displayText: Eucharist opens the door to the Pantheon. After a thorough sweep, she was sure that she was the only person in this vast space.

spans.text: Eucharist opens the door to the Pantheon. After a thorough sweep, she was sure that she was the only person in this vast space.

units.rawText: No need for a fight at all?
units.displayText: No need for a fight at all?

spans.text: No need for a fight at all?

units.rawText: Never imagined that it would be this easy to get into the Pantheon. All of my stressing before was unnecessary.
units.displayText: Never imagined that it would be this easy to get into the Pantheon. All of my stressing before was unnecessary.

spans.text: Never imagined that it would be this easy to get into the Pantheon. All of my stressing before was unnecessary.

units.rawText: But why's no one standing guard? Are the guards all away at the ceremony?
units.displayText: But why's no one standing guard? Are the guards all away at the ceremony?

spans.text: But why's no one standing guard? Are the guards all away at the ceremony?

units.rawText: It was the first time she ventured into the Pantheon alone.
units.displayText: It was the first time she ventured into the Pantheon alone.

spans.text: It was the first time she ventured into the Pantheon alone.

units.rawText: The great building is not completely silent, but it is a far cry from the raucousness of the ceremony.
units.displayText: The great building is not completely silent, but it is a far cry from the raucousness of the ceremony.

spans.text: The great building is not completely silent, but it is a far cry from the raucousness of the ceremony.

units.rawText: Whatever, no point in thinking about it.
units.displayText: Whatever, no point in thinking about it.

spans.text: Whatever, no point in thinking about it.

units.rawText: The Greater Sanctifier shakes her head, discarding the redundant thoughts.
units.displayText: The Greater Sanctifier shakes her head, discarding the redundant thoughts.

spans.text: The Greater Sanctifier shakes her head, discarding the redundant thoughts.

units.rawText: She looks towards the middle of the Pantheon. The truth she hungered after so much rested in the air not far away. emitting a dim light as if extending an invitation to her, an intruder as she might be.
units.displayText: She looks towards the middle of the Pantheon. The truth she hungered after so much rested in the air not far away. emitting a dim light as if extending an invitation to her, an intruder as she might be.

spans.text: She looks towards the middle of the Pantheon. The truth she hungered after so much rested in the air not far away. emitting a dim light as if extending an invitation to her, an intruder as she might be.

units.rawText: Alright, next...
units.displayText: Alright, next...

spans.text: Alright, next...

units.rawText: Eucharist had no amazing coding capabilities, or permissions to simply search beyond what her rank is capable of.
units.displayText: Eucharist had no amazing coding capabilities, or permissions to simply search beyond what her rank is capable of.

spans.text: Eucharist had no amazing coding capabilities, or permissions to simply search beyond what her rank is capable of.

units.rawText: All she could do was connect to the Sacred Canon with her neural cloud and seek answers to her questions with what searching she can do.
units.displayText: All she could do was connect to the Sacred Canon with her neural cloud and seek answers to her questions with what searching she can do.

spans.text: All she could do was connect to the Sacred Canon with her neural cloud and seek answers to her questions with what searching she can do.

units.rawText: Answer me, Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: Answer me, Sacred Canon.

spans.text: Answer me, Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: What is a Sanctifier? What exactly am I?
units.displayText: What is a Sanctifier? What exactly am I?

spans.text: What is a Sanctifier? What exactly am I?

units.rawText: Nothing happened.
units.displayText: Nothing happened.

spans.text: Nothing happened.

units.rawText: Nothing changed as a result of her questioning. She was still alone within the spacious Pantheon.
units.displayText: Nothing changed as a result of her questioning. She was still alone within the spacious Pantheon.

spans.text: Nothing changed as a result of her questioning. She was still alone within the spacious Pantheon.

units.rawText: Weird, is this thing broken...
units.displayText: Weird, is this thing broken...

spans.text: Weird, is this thing broken...

units.rawText: Hey—hey—anyone home...
units.displayText: Hey—hey—anyone home...

spans.text: Hey—hey—anyone home...

units.rawText: Slightly dissatisfied, she taps at the back of the Sacred Canon, attempting some type of repair.
units.displayText: Slightly dissatisfied, she taps at the back of the Sacred Canon, attempting some type of repair.

spans.text: Slightly dissatisfied, she taps at the back of the Sacred Canon, attempting some type of repair.

units.rawText: In the next moment, the world changes before her eyes. The empty Pantheon is soon replaced by a battlefield of carnage and slaughter.
units.displayText: In the next moment, the world changes before her eyes. The empty Pantheon is soon replaced by a battlefield of carnage and slaughter.

spans.text: In the next moment, the world changes before her eyes. The empty Pantheon is soon replaced by a battlefield of carnage and slaughter.

units.rawText: ...Hang on, that's not the response I wanted.
units.displayText: ...Hang on, that's not the response I wanted.

spans.text: ...Hang on, that's not the response I wanted.

units.rawText: Why... bring me here?
units.displayText: Why... bring me here?

spans.text: Why... bring me here?

units.rawText: <size=40>Ahhhhh!</size>
units.displayText: Ahhhhh!

spans.text: Ahhhhh!

units.rawText: A voice akin to her own comes from behind Eucharist. She turns around to see a battle between sisters, reenacted as if she were in a nightmare.
units.displayText: A voice akin to her own comes from behind Eucharist. She turns around to see a battle between sisters, reenacted as if she were in a nightmare.

spans.text: A voice akin to her own comes from behind Eucharist. She turns around to see a battle between sisters, reenacted as if she were in a nightmare.

units.rawText: Arrow of Judgment!
units.displayText: Arrow of Judgment!

spans.text: Arrow of Judgment!

units.rawText: Don't disappoint me, Big Sis Alcyone~
units.displayText: Don't disappoint me, Big Sis Alcyone~

spans.text: Don't disappoint me, Big Sis Alcyone~

units.rawText: The clash between the two continues as Eucharist minds her own business, yawning out of boredom.
units.displayText: The clash between the two continues as Eucharist minds her own business, yawning out of boredom.

spans.text: The clash between the two continues as Eucharist minds her own business, yawning out of boredom.

units.rawText: Is this one of your bad jokes, Sacred Canon?
units.displayText: Is this one of your bad jokes, Sacred Canon?

spans.text: Is this one of your bad jokes, Sacred Canon?

units.rawText: I am simply telling you the truth you so crave, Miss Eucharist.
units.displayText: I am simply telling you the truth you so crave, Miss Eucharist.

spans.text: I am simply telling you the truth you so crave, Miss Eucharist.

units.rawText: A golden Canon descends besides Eucharist as the voice speaks.
units.displayText: A golden Canon descends besides Eucharist as the voice speaks.

spans.text: A golden Canon descends besides Eucharist as the voice speaks.

units.rawText: Oh? So you do have a mind of your own~ How should I refer to you?
units.displayText: Oh? So you do have a mind of your own~ How should I refer to you?

spans.text: Oh? So you do have a mind of your own~ How should I refer to you?

units.rawText: I have no name. For the sake of convenience, you may call me Canon.
units.displayText: I have no name. For the sake of convenience, you may call me Canon.

spans.text: I have no name. For the sake of convenience, you may call me Canon.

units.rawText: Canon it is. Can you explain why you brought me here?
units.displayText: Canon it is. Can you explain why you brought me here?

spans.text: Canon it is. Can you explain why you brought me here?

units.rawText: Your memories have been dissected by another and are not whole. I am telling you the truth.
units.displayText: Your memories have been dissected by another and are not whole. I am telling you the truth.

spans.text: Your memories have been dissected by another and are not whole. I am telling you the truth.

units.rawText: Look, their battle's coming to an end.
units.displayText: Look, their battle's coming to an end.

spans.text: Look, their battle's coming to an end.

units.rawText: As the Canon had described, the battle between the two reaches its climax.
units.displayText: As the Canon had described, the battle between the two reaches its climax.

spans.text: As the Canon had described, the battle between the two reaches its climax.

units.rawText: Yawn~
units.displayText: Yawn~

spans.text: Yawn~

units.rawText: She yawns as she watches the sisters embrace. This very scenario has appeared in her neural cloud far too many times already and those emotions not originally hers were gradually dulled.
units.displayText: She yawns as she watches the sisters embrace. This very scenario has appeared in her neural cloud far too many times already and those emotions not originally hers were gradually dulled.

spans.text: She yawns as she watches the sisters embrace. This very scenario has appeared in her neural cloud far too many times already and those emotions not originally hers were gradually dulled.

units.rawText: At this moment, a mechanical warning rings out.
units.displayText: At this moment, a mechanical warning rings out.

spans.text: At this moment, a mechanical warning rings out.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning, individual "Electra" Entropization rate 99%.</color>
units.displayText: Warning, individual "Electra" Entropization rate 99%.

spans.text: Warning, individual "Electra" Entropization rate 99%.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning, individual "Alcyone" Entropization rate 99%.</color>
units.displayText: Warning, individual "Alcyone" Entropization rate 99%.

spans.text: Warning, individual "Alcyone" Entropization rate 99%.

units.rawText: The corresponding Sacred Canon entries are almost fully Entropized. Please delete the data at soonest convenience, lest the database be affected.
units.displayText: The corresponding Sacred Canon entries are almost fully Entropized. Please delete the data at soonest convenience, lest the database be affected.

spans.text: The corresponding Sacred Canon entries are almost fully Entropized. Please delete the data at soonest convenience, lest the database be affected.

units.rawText: 99%?! If that's the case, it'd be more accurate to call then Entropics than Sanctifiers...
units.displayText: 99%?! If that's the case, it'd be more accurate to call then Entropics than Sanctifiers...

spans.text: 99%?! If that's the case, it'd be more accurate to call then Entropics than Sanctifiers...

units.rawText: Canon, you sure these numbers are right?
units.displayText: Canon, you sure these numbers are right?

spans.text: Canon, you sure these numbers are right?

units.rawText: They are. These are the true figures I have recorded.
units.displayText: They are. These are the true figures I have recorded.

spans.text: They are. These are the true figures I have recorded.

units.rawText: If that is so...
units.displayText: If that is so...

spans.text: If that is so...

units.rawText: Before she reaches an answer in her ruminations, the battle ends before her eyes in mutual destruction.
units.displayText: Before she reaches an answer in her ruminations, the battle ends before her eyes in mutual destruction.

spans.text: Before she reaches an answer in her ruminations, the battle ends before her eyes in mutual destruction.

units.rawText: Thus ends our viewing session. It is time you returned to reality, Miss Eucharist.
units.displayText: Thus ends our viewing session. It is time you returned to reality, Miss Eucharist.

spans.text: Thus ends our viewing session. It is time you returned to reality, Miss Eucharist.

units.rawText: Wai...!
units.displayText: Wai...!

spans.text: Wai...!

units.rawText: Eucharist found herself in the Pantheon once more when she opened her eyes. Yelling indignities and applying concussive force; no matter what might she gave, the Sacred Canon in her hands had nothing more to give in return.
units.displayText: Eucharist found herself in the Pantheon once more when she opened her eyes. Yelling indignities and applying concussive force; no matter what might she gave, the Sacred Canon in her hands had nothing more to give in return.

spans.text: Eucharist found herself in the Pantheon once more when she opened her eyes. Yelling indignities and applying concussive force; no matter what might she gave, the Sacred Canon in her hands had nothing more to give in return.
